reponse:
Yes, both were picked up. The webhook problem is fixed, but the payout-schedule request has been turned down for Dec 7.

**1. Webhook signature failures on sandbox.** Ellen Vance said every `payout.paid` and `seller.verified` event failed HMAC verification, with about 1 in 20 passing. Tradewell had turned verification off on sandbox as a workaround [1]. Jake Whitfield took it on the call [1]. On Nov 16 he opened core#1187, which fixes the cause. The delivery worker re-serialized the JSON after it was signed, so the body sent was not the body signed [2]. The PR is merged and deployed to sandbox. It reaches production with release 2026.47 on Tue Nov 24 [2].

**2. Per-seller payout schedules.** About 200 top sellers are on net-7 and everyone else is on net-30. Quillon currently supports one schedule per platform [1]. Owen Park didn't commit on the call [1]. He then told Martin in Slack that he'd have a clear answer by Fri Nov 20 [3]. Tomer Golan estimated 3–4 weeks of work [4]. On Nov 16 Avi Kessler decided it is "Not for Dec 7". He said the earliest is late January and moved the ticket to Backlog with a Q1 2027 target. He also asked Owen to set expectations with Martin [4].

I found no sign yet that Owen has told Martin. Martin said he needs an answer soon and that Tradewell has to tell those sellers what happens in December [1]. He also said Dec 7 can't move [1], so the gap is still open.

Sources:
[1] Gong, Tradewell weekly onboarding sync, Nov 12
[2] GitHub, core#1187
[3] Slack, #ext-tradewell
[4] Jira, QPAY-2362
